title: Facet-defect coupling in CuO catalysts boosts ammonia oxidation kinetics
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00071A, Paper
Mengyuan Zhao, Shaohan Liang, Junhui Liang, Jiahui Hou, Jiangchao Lou, Xin Yao, Huayu Chen, Feng Zhou, Huaizhou Jin, Da Chen
Facet-defect coupling regulates ammonia oxidation kinetics and selectivity, with exposed (002)/(111) facets promoting N2 formation and oxygen vacancies favoring oxidized nitrogen species.
